ungradable_reasons: Canonical player/team/game/season/date and independent hockey truth ungraded.

one_family_split_mode: grade each arm directly; do not call freeze_splits or invent six families
rules_producer: Unchanged rules-adapter.ts using actual repository extractors; output projection limitations stay charged to this arm, not claimed as full native-pipeline behavior.
extraction_producer: Luna Responses, exact same source/context as rules; claim-schema.json plus pilot-extraction-prompt.txt, no labels/other-arm outputs in request.
verification: For each producer, preserve its exact candidate IDs and full declared fields, original source and exact UTF-16 evidence. Direct source-support/wording questions about literal player name, no canonical numeric-ID prerequisite. This is a new evaluation-only API contract, not the accepted native mapper. Unknown/refusal/bad binding cannot promote eligibility.
output_identity: player and original source author/ID are source-only; player_id stays null and is ungradable. Retained roster candidates assist both producers equally but do not prove current membership.
statement_serialization: Existing statement(claim): all twelve declared fields, deterministic sorted JSON; evidence and source bound separately. No stronger prose or inferred date.
source_eligibility: Existing qualify() equally for both producers; IR time unknown holds, approximate absence time remains literal. Existing apply_decisions() can only remove source eligibility; supported=true, confidence>=0.95 and direct_assertion required. An expectation classification can conservatively hold a valid forecast; count the resulting miss/abstention, never reinterpret as a correct negative.
native_eligibility: Always false for every arm; historical development source, no claim/status/publication authority.
scoring: Corrected grade() with matched gold-gradable field denominators, one-to-one matching, raw TP/FP/FN plus source-eligible precision/recall/holds separately. Approximation and cause are material. Unmatched assertions are claim FP/hallucinations; unmatched field values reported separately, excluded from matched-field precision. No winner or confidence interval inference from this development family.
vocabulary: Generic frozen extraction encoding: IR placement => event injury/value injured_reserve; injury-caused absence => event availability/value out; cause=<exact injury phrase>. Literal team hashtag/role only when supported. Other claims remain visible, not forced into these two gold slots.
